mdr_sa_share_science_begin = {
	clr_country_flag = mdr_sa_share_science_queued
	set_country_flag = mdr_sa_share_science_run
	set_variable = { mdr_sa_share_science_left = 12 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_active = 1 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_science = -30 }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

# Weekly, before mdr_space_refresh: closes the year when it changes and adds this week's cost.
mdr_space_spend_track = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = mdr_space_spend_year NOT = { check_variable = { var = mdr_space_spend_year compare = equals value = global.year } } }
		set_temp_variable = { mdr_space_spend_gap = global.year }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { mdr_space_spend_gap = mdr_space_spend_year }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_4 = mdr_space_spend_3 }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_3 = mdr_space_spend_2 }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_2 = mdr_space_spend_1 }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_1 = mdr_space_spend_0 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_spend_gap > 1 } }
			set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_1 = 0 }
			set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_2 = 0 }
			set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_3 = 0 }
			set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_4 = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = 0 }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_year = global.year }
	}
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = mdr_space_week_cost }
}

# From mdr_space_refresh: the height of each bar against the highest year, and the year under it.
mdr_space_spend_chart = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = mdr_space_spend_year } }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_year = global.year }
		if = { limit = { date < 2000.6.1 }
			set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_1 = mdr_space_week_cost }
			multiply_variable = { mdr_space_spend_1 = 52 }
			set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_2 = mdr_space_spend_1 }
			set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_3 = mdr_space_spend_1 }
			set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_4 = mdr_space_spend_1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_max = 0.01 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_space_spend_0 compare = greater_than value = mdr_space_spend_max } } set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_max = mdr_space_spend_0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_space_spend_1 compare = greater_than value = mdr_space_spend_max } } set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_max = mdr_space_spend_1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_space_spend_2 compare = greater_than value = mdr_space_spend_max } } set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_max = mdr_space_spend_2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_space_spend_3 compare = greater_than value = mdr_space_spend_max } } set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_max = mdr_space_spend_3 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_space_spend_4 compare = greater_than value = mdr_space_spend_max } } set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_max = mdr_space_spend_4 } }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_0 = mdr_space_spend_0 }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_0 = 50 }
	divide_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_0 = mdr_space_spend_max }
	round_variable = mdr_space_spend_frame_0
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_0 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_y0 = mdr_space_spend_year }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_1 = mdr_space_spend_1 }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_1 = 50 }
	divide_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_1 = mdr_space_spend_max }
	round_variable = mdr_space_spend_frame_1
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_y1 = mdr_space_spend_year }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_y1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_2 = mdr_space_spend_2 }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_2 = 50 }
	divide_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_2 = mdr_space_spend_max }
	round_variable = mdr_space_spend_frame_2
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_y2 = mdr_space_spend_year }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_y2 = 2 }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_3 = mdr_space_spend_3 }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_3 = 50 }
	divide_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_3 = mdr_space_spend_max }
	round_variable = mdr_space_spend_frame_3
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_y3 = mdr_space_spend_year }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_y3 = 3 }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_4 = mdr_space_spend_4 }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_4 = 50 }
	divide_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_4 = mdr_space_spend_max }
	round_variable = mdr_space_spend_frame_4
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_spend_frame_4 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_spend_y4 = mdr_space_spend_year }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_y4 = 4 }
}

mdr_space_program_start = {
	set_variable = { mdr_space_cat_p = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_cat_d = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_body = 3 }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_colony_view = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_hq = mdr_space_tier }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_hq < 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_hq = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_tier = 3 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_scientists = 1240 }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_engineers = 3800 }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_tier = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_scientists = 420 }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_engineers = 1300 }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_tier = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_scientists = 120 }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_engineers = 360 }
	}
	if = { limit = { original_tag = USA }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_astronauts = 146 }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_prestige = 40 }
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_astro_corps_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_crew_capsule_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_eva_suit_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_engine_test_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_probe_moon_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_probe_venus_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_probe_mars_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_probe_jupiter_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_probe_saturn_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_crew_moon_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_space_telescope_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_join_iss_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_space_treaty_done
	}
	else_if = { limit = { original_tag = SOV }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_astronauts = 40 }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_prestige = 28 }
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_astro_corps_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_crew_capsule_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_eva_suit_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_engine_test_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_probe_moon_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_probe_venus_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_probe_mars_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_own_station_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_join_iss_done
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_space_treaty_done
		add_to_variable = { mdr_space_extra_slots = 1 }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_tier = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_astronauts = 6 }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_prestige = 6 }
		set_country_flag = mdr_sa_engine_test_done
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_tier = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mdr_space_prestige = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdr_space_program_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdr_space_program_modifier } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdr_space_standing_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = mdr_space_standing_modifier } }
}

# Country init, after the first refresh: goals reached before 2000 count as claimed, without their reward again.
mdr_space_claim_past_goals = {
	if = { limit = { mdr_sg_orbit_met = yes } set_country_flag = mdr_sg_orbit_claimed }
	if = { limit = { mdr_sg_crew_met = yes } set_country_flag = mdr_sg_crew_claimed }
	if = { limit = { mdr_sg_station_met = yes } set_country_flag = mdr_sg_station_claimed }
	if = { limit = { mdr_sg_moon_return_met = yes } set_country_flag = mdr_sg_moon_return_claimed }
	if = { limit = { mdr_sg_moon_colony_met = yes } set_country_flag = mdr_sg_moon_colony_claimed }
	if = { limit = { mdr_sg_mars_robot_met = yes } set_country_flag = mdr_sg_mars_robot_claimed }
	if = { limit = { mdr_sg_mars_crew_met = yes } set_country_flag = mdr_sg_mars_crew_claimed }
	if = { limit = { mdr_sg_mars_colony_met = yes } set_country_flag = mdr_sg_mars_colony_claimed }
}

# A launch: 84% plus the launcher reliability, up to 97%. Output: mdr_space_roll_failed.
mdr_space_roll = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_space_chance = modifier@olv_launch_reliability_modifier }
	add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_space_chance = 0.84 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_chance > 0.97 } } set_temp_variable = { mdr_space_chance = 0.97 } }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_space_dice = random }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_space_dice compare = greater_than value = mdr_space_chance } } set_variable = { mdr_space_roll_failed = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { mdr_space_roll_failed = 0 } }
}

# Country scope, weekly: everything that moves in an agency.
mdr_space_program_weekly = {
	# Scientists: 0.4 science a week per hundred.
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_space_staff_science = mdr_space_scientists }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_space_staff_science = 0.004 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_science = mdr_space_staff_science }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_active > 0 } } mdr_space_actions_weekly = yes }
	mdr_space_queue_weekly = yes
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_moon } mdr_col_moon_weekly = yes mdr_moon_weekly = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_mars } mdr_col_mars_weekly = yes mdr_mars_weekly = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_venus } mdr_col_venus_weekly = yes mdr_venus_weekly = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_mercury } mdr_col_mercury_weekly = yes mdr_mercury_weekly = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_asteroids } mdr_col_asteroids_weekly = yes mdr_asteroids_weekly = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_callisto } mdr_col_callisto_weekly = yes mdr_callisto_weekly = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_titan } mdr_col_titan_weekly = yes mdr_titan_weekly = yes }
	mdr_space_standing_update = yes
	# The player's automatic mode (herramientas/space_auto.py).
	if = { limit = { is_ai = no has_country_flag = mdr_space_auto } mdr_space_auto_weekly = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_ai = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_space_active compare = less_than value = mdr_space_slots } }
			random_list = {
				12 = { mdr_space_ai_projects = yes }
				88 = { }
			}
		}
		# Its Mars colony grows by itself (herramientas/space_colony.py).
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_moon check_variable = { treasury > 12 } }
			random_list = {
				14 = { mdr_moon_auto = yes }
				86 = { }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_mars check_variable = { treasury > 12 } }
			random_list = {
				14 = { mdr_mars_auto = yes }
				86 = { }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_venus check_variable = { treasury > 12 } }
			random_list = {
				14 = { mdr_venus_auto = yes }
				86 = { }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_mercury check_variable = { treasury > 12 } }
			random_list = {
				14 = { mdr_mercury_auto = yes }
				86 = { }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_asteroids check_variable = { treasury > 12 } }
			random_list = {
				14 = { mdr_asteroids_auto = yes }
				86 = { }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_callisto check_variable = { treasury > 12 } }
			random_list = {
				14 = { mdr_callisto_auto = yes }
				86 = { }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_titan check_variable = { treasury > 12 } }
			random_list = {
				14 = { mdr_titan_auto = yes }
				86 = { }
			}
		}
		# One service a year or so, while the treasury has room.
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { treasury > 15 } }
			random_list = {
				2 = { mdr_space_ai_contracts = yes }
				98 = { }
			}
		}
		# It keeps a budget according to its level, and grows if it is rich.
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_budget < 12 } check_variable = { treasury > 20 } check_variable = { gdp_total > 600 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_budget = 12 } }
	}
}

# Slots, prestige, colonies and debris as modifiers.
mdr_space_standing_update = {
	set_variable = { mdr_space_slots = 1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_hq > 2 } } add_to_variable = { mdr_space_slots = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_hq > 4 } } add_to_variable = { mdr_space_slots = 1 } }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_slots = mdr_space_extra_slots }
	# Prestige: 0.04% stability and 0.03% political power per point. Failed launches cannot take it below zero.
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_prestige < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_prestige = 0 } }
	set_variable = { mdr_st_stability = mdr_space_prestige }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_st_stability = 0.0004 }
	set_variable = { mdr_st_pp = mdr_space_prestige }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_st_pp = 0.0003 }
	# Debris: up to -9% launch reliability and +12% launcher cost at 100.
	set_variable = { mdr_st_debris_r = global.mdr_space_debris }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_st_debris_r = -0.0009 }
	set_variable = { mdr_st_debris_c = global.mdr_space_debris }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_st_debris_c = 0.0012 }
	# Colonies: research per settler, factories per workshop.
	set_variable = { mdr_st_col_research = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_col_research = mdr_col_moon_pop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_col_research = mdr_col_mars_pop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_col_research = mdr_col_venus_pop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_col_research = mdr_col_mercury_pop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_col_research = mdr_col_asteroids_pop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_col_research = mdr_col_callisto_pop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_col_research = mdr_col_titan_pop }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_st_col_research = 0.00008 }
	set_variable = { mdr_st_col_factory = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_col_factory = mdr_col_moon_workshop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_col_factory = mdr_col_mars_workshop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_col_factory = mdr_col_venus_workshop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_col_factory = mdr_col_mercury_workshop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_col_factory = mdr_col_asteroids_workshop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_col_factory = mdr_col_callisto_workshop }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_col_factory = mdr_col_titan_workshop }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_st_col_factory = 0.003 }
	# Payroll and supply routes, paid with the budget (mdr_space_refresh adds them to the expense).
	set_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = mdr_space_scientists }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = mdr_space_engineers }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.00002 }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_space_astro_pay = mdr_space_astronauts }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_space_astro_pay = 0.0004 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = mdr_space_astro_pay }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_moon_route } add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.09 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_mars_route } add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.34 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_venus_route } add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.41 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_mercury_route } add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.52 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_asteroids_route } add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.38 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_callisto_route } add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.74 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_titan_route } add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.88 } }
	set_variable = { mdr_space_contract_cost = 0 }
	# Private companies: one per service. A contract ends by itself if the company can no longer be hired.
	set_variable = { mdr_pc_olv_c = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdr_pc_olv_s = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdr_pc_olv_r = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdr_pc_science = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdr_pc_budget = 0 }
	set_variable = { mdr_pc_intel = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view < 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_arianespace_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 0 } }
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.043 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_contract_cost = 0.043 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_olv_c = -0.07 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_olv_r = 0.012 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_ils_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 0 } }
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.038 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_contract_cost = 0.038 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_olv_c = -0.09 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_great_wall_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 0 } }
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.027 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_contract_cost = 0.027 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_olv_c = -0.11 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_olv_r = -0.008 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 4 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_antrix_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 0 } }
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.021 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_contract_cost = 0.021 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_olv_c = -0.06 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_sat = 0.017 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 5 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_mhi_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 0 } }
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.052 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_contract_cost = 0.052 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_olv_c = -0.04 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_olv_r = 0.024 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 6 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_spacex_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 0 } }
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.047 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_contract_cost = 0.047 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_olv_c = -0.16 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_olv_s = 0.037 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 7 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_rocket_lab_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 0 } }
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.019 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_contract_cost = 0.019 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_sat = 0.043 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_olv_c = -0.03 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_view < 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_view = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_loral_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed = 0 } }
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.034 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_contract_cost = 0.034 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_sat = 0.046 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_astrium_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed = 0 } }
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.041 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_contract_cost = 0.041 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_sat = 0.038 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_science = 0.012 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_sstl_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed = 0 } }
		else = {

			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_sat = 0.027 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_budget = -0.011 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed = 4 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_thales_alenia_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed = 0 } }

			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_sat = 0.052 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_science = 0.008 }
		}
	}

		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_view < 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_view = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_signed = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_spacehab_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_signed = 0 } }
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.031 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_contract_cost = 0.031 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_science = 0.034 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_signed = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_glavkosmos_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_signed = 0 } }
		else = {

		else = {

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view < 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view = 1 } }

		else = {
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.024 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_contract_cost = 0.024 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_budget = -0.019 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_intel = 0.006 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_data_signed = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_digitalglobe_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_signed = 0 } }
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.029 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_contract_cost = 0.029 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_budget = -0.033 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_intel = 0.014 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_data_signed = 4 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { mdr_pco_planet_open = yes } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_signed = 0 } }
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_payroll = 0.026 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_space_contract_cost = 0.026 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_budget = -0.031 }
			add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_intel = 0.019 }
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { mdr_st_debris_r = mdr_pc_olv_r }
}

mdr_space_ai_contracts = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed < 1 } OR = { mdr_pco_arianespace_open = yes mdr_pco_ils_open = yes mdr_pco_great_wall_open = yes mdr_pco_antrix_open = yes mdr_pco_mhi_open = yes mdr_pco_spacex_open = yes mdr_pco_rocket_lab_open = yes } }
		if = { limit = { mdr_pco_arianespace_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 1 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_ils_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 2 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_great_wall_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 3 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 3 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_antrix_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 4 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 4 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_mhi_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 5 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 5 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_spacex_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 6 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 6 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_rocket_lab_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed = 7 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_view = 7 } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed < 1 } OR = { mdr_pco_loral_open = yes mdr_pco_astrium_open = yes mdr_pco_sstl_open = yes mdr_pco_thales_alenia_open = yes mdr_pco_oneweb_open = yes } }
		if = { limit = { mdr_pco_loral_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed = 1 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_view = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_astrium_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed = 2 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_view = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_sstl_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed = 3 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_view = 3 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_thales_alenia_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed = 4 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_view = 4 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_oneweb_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed = 5 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_view = 5 } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_signed < 1 } OR = { mdr_pco_spacehab_open = yes mdr_pco_glavkosmos_open = yes mdr_pco_space_adventures_open = yes mdr_pco_spacex_dragon_open = yes mdr_pco_axiom_open = yes } }
		if = { limit = { mdr_pco_spacehab_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_signed = 1 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_view = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_glavkosmos_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_signed = 2 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_view = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_space_adventures_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_signed = 3 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_view = 3 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_spacex_dragon_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_signed = 4 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_view = 4 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_axiom_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_signed = 5 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_view = 5 } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_data_signed < 1 } OR = { mdr_pco_spot_image_open = yes mdr_pco_iridium_open = yes mdr_pco_digitalglobe_open = yes mdr_pco_planet_open = yes } }
		if = { limit = { mdr_pco_spot_image_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_signed = 1 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_iridium_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_signed = 2 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_digitalglobe_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_signed = 3 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view = 3 } }
		else_if = { limit = { mdr_pco_planet_open = yes } set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_signed = 4 } set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view = 4 } }
	}
}

mdr_space_upgrade_hq = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_space_hq_money = mdr_space_hq }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_space_hq_money = -1.2 }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = mdr_space_hq_money }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_space_hq_science = mdr_space_hq }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_space_hq_science = -40 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_science = mdr_space_hq_science }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_hq = 1 }
	mdr_space_refresh = yes
}

# World, weekly: every launch leaves something behind.
mdr_space_debris_weekly = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = mdr_space_debris_started } }
		set_global_flag = mdr_space_debris_started
		set_variable = { global.mdr_space_debris = 8 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.mdr_space_debris = 0.021 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_space_debris < 0 } } set_variable = { global.mdr_space_debris = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_space_debris > 100 } } set_variable = { global.mdr_space_debris = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.mdr_space_debris > 70 } NOT = { has_global_flag = mdr_space_kessler_warned } }
		set_global_flag = mdr_space_kessler_warned
		every_country = { limit = { is_ai = no check_variable = { mdr_space_tier > 0 } } country_event = { id = mdr_space.3 } }
	}
}

mdr_col_moon_found = {
	set_country_flag = mdr_col_moon
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_pop = 12 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_cap = 40 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_morale = 70 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water = 60 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food = 60 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy = 60 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen = 60 }
	mdr_col_moon_frames = yes
}

mdr_col_moon_frames = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = mdr_col_moon_pop }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = -0.05 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_moon_route } add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = 6 } }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water_net = mdr_col_moon_mine }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water_net = 0.8 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food_net = mdr_col_moon_greenhouse }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food_net = 0.9 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy_net = mdr_col_moon_reactor }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy_net = 1.1 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen_net = mdr_col_moon_mine }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen_net = 0.8 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water_frame = mdr_col_moon_water }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_moon_water_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food_frame = mdr_col_moon_food }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_moon_food_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy_frame = mdr_col_moon_energy }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_moon_energy_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen_frame = mdr_col_moon_oxygen }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_moon_oxygen_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen_frame = 1 }
}

# Each settler uses supplies; modules make them, and the route brings 6 of each a week.
mdr_col_moon_weekly = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = mdr_col_moon_pop }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = 0.05 }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water = mdr_col_use }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food = mdr_col_use }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy = mdr_col_use }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen = mdr_col_use }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = mdr_col_moon_greenhouse }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = 0.9 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food = mdr_col_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = mdr_col_moon_mine }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = 0.8 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water = mdr_col_made }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen = mdr_col_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = mdr_col_moon_reactor }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = 1.1 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy = mdr_col_made }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_moon_route }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water = 6 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food = 6 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy = 6 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen = 6 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_water < 15 } check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_food < 15 } check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_energy < 15 } check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_oxygen < 15 } } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_morale = -3 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_morale < 25 } check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_pop > 0 } } add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_pop = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_moon_warned } } set_country_flag = mdr_col_moon_warned country_event = { id = mdr_space.4 } }
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = mdr_col_moon_warned
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_morale < 100 } } add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_morale = 1 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_moon_morale < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_morale = 0 } }
	# Science of the colony.
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_science = mdr_col_moon_pop }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_science = 0.09 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_science = mdr_col_science }
	mdr_col_moon_frames = yes
}

mdr_col_moon_send = {
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_moon_pop = 4 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_col_moon_pop compare = greater_than value = mdr_col_moon_cap } } set_variable = { mdr_col_moon_pop = mdr_col_moon_cap } }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.4 }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

}

mdr_col_venus_frames = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = mdr_col_venus_pop }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = -0.05 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_venus_route } add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = 6 } }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water_net = mdr_col_venus_mine }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water_net = 0.8 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food_net = mdr_col_venus_greenhouse }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food_net = 0.9 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy_net = mdr_col_venus_reactor }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy_net = 1.1 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen_net = mdr_col_venus_mine }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen_net = 0.8 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water_frame = mdr_col_venus_water }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_venus_water_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food_frame = mdr_col_venus_food }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_venus_food_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy_frame = mdr_col_venus_energy }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_venus_energy_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen_frame = mdr_col_venus_oxygen }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_venus_oxygen_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen_frame = 1 }
}

# Each settler uses supplies; modules make them, and the route brings 6 of each a week.
mdr_col_venus_weekly = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = mdr_col_venus_pop }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = 0.05 }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water = mdr_col_use }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food = mdr_col_use }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy = mdr_col_use }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen = mdr_col_use }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = mdr_col_venus_greenhouse }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = 0.9 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food = mdr_col_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = mdr_col_venus_mine }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = 0.8 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water = mdr_col_made }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen = mdr_col_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = mdr_col_venus_reactor }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = 1.1 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy = mdr_col_made }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_venus_route }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water = 6 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food = 6 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy = 6 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen = 6 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_water < 15 } check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_food < 15 } check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_energy < 15 } check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_oxygen < 15 } } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_morale = -3 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_morale < 25 } check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_pop > 0 } } add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_pop = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_venus_warned } } set_country_flag = mdr_col_venus_warned country_event = { id = mdr_space.4 } }
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = mdr_col_venus_warned
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_morale < 100 } } add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_morale = 1 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_venus_morale < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_morale = 0 } }
	# Science of the colony.
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_science = mdr_col_venus_pop }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_science = 0.09 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_science = mdr_col_science }
	mdr_col_venus_frames = yes
}

mdr_col_venus_send = {
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_venus_pop = 4 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_col_venus_pop compare = greater_than value = mdr_col_venus_cap } } set_variable = { mdr_col_venus_pop = mdr_col_venus_cap } }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1.6 }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

mdr_col_mercury_found = {
	set_country_flag = mdr_col_mercury
	set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_pop = 12 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_cap = 12 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_morale = 70 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_water = 60 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_food = 60 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_energy = 60 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_oxygen = 60 }
	mdr_col_mercury_frames = yes
}

	set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_food_net = mdr_col_mercury_greenhouse }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_food_net = 0.9 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_food_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_energy_net = mdr_col_mercury_reactor }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_energy_net = 1.1 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_energy_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_oxygen_net = mdr_col_mercury_mine }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_oxygen_net = 0.8 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_oxygen_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_water_frame = mdr_col_mercury_water }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_water_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_mercury_water_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_water_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_food_frame = mdr_col_mercury_food }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_food_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_mercury_food_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_food_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_energy_frame = mdr_col_mercury_energy }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_energy_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_mercury_energy_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_energy_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_oxygen_frame = mdr_col_mercury_oxygen }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_oxygen_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_mercury_oxygen_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_mercury_oxygen_frame = 1 }
}

	set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_food_net = mdr_col_callisto_greenhouse }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_food_net = 0.9 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_food_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_energy_net = mdr_col_callisto_reactor }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_energy_net = 1.1 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_energy_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_oxygen_net = mdr_col_callisto_mine }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_oxygen_net = 0.8 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_oxygen_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_water_frame = mdr_col_callisto_water }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_water_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_callisto_water_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_water_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_food_frame = mdr_col_callisto_food }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_food_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_callisto_food_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_food_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_energy_frame = mdr_col_callisto_energy }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_energy_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_callisto_energy_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_energy_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_oxygen_frame = mdr_col_callisto_oxygen }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_oxygen_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_callisto_oxygen_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_oxygen_frame = 1 }
}

# Each settler uses supplies; modules make them, and the route brings 6 of each a week.
mdr_col_callisto_weekly = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = mdr_col_callisto_pop }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = 0.05 }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_water = mdr_col_use }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_food = mdr_col_use }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_energy = mdr_col_use }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_oxygen = mdr_col_use }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = mdr_col_callisto_greenhouse }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = 0.9 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_food = mdr_col_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = mdr_col_callisto_mine }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = 0.8 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_water = mdr_col_made }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_oxygen = mdr_col_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = mdr_col_callisto_reactor }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = 1.1 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_energy = mdr_col_made }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_callisto_route }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_water = 6 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_food = 6 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_energy = 6 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_oxygen = 6 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_water < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_water = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_water > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_water = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_food < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_food = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_food > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_food = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_energy < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_energy = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_energy > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_energy = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_oxygen < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_oxygen = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_oxygen > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_oxygen = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_water < 15 } check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_food < 15 } check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_energy < 15 } check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_oxygen < 15 } } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_morale = -3 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_morale < 25 } check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_pop > 0 } } add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_pop = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_callisto_warned } } set_country_flag = mdr_col_callisto_warned country_event = { id = mdr_space.4 } }
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = mdr_col_callisto_warned
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_morale < 100 } } add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_morale = 1 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_morale < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_morale = 0 } }
	# Science of the colony.
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_science = mdr_col_callisto_pop }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_science = 0.09 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_science = mdr_col_science }
	mdr_col_callisto_frames = yes
}

mdr_col_callisto_send = {
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_pop = 4 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_col_callisto_pop compare = greater_than value = mdr_col_callisto_cap } } set_variable = { mdr_col_callisto_pop = mdr_col_callisto_cap } }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -2.6 }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_space_spend_0 = treasury_change }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
}

mdr_col_titan_found = {
	set_country_flag = mdr_col_titan
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_pop = 12 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_cap = 18 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_morale = 70 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_water = 60 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_food = 60 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_energy = 60 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_oxygen = 60 }
	mdr_col_titan_frames = yes
}

mdr_col_titan_frames = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = mdr_col_titan_pop }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = -0.05 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_titan_route } add_to_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = 6 } }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_water_net = mdr_col_titan_mine }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_titan_water_net = 0.8 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_water_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_food_net = mdr_col_titan_greenhouse }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_titan_food_net = 0.9 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_food_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_energy_net = mdr_col_titan_reactor }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_titan_energy_net = 1.1 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_energy_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_oxygen_net = mdr_col_titan_mine }
	multiply_variable = { mdr_col_titan_oxygen_net = 0.8 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_oxygen_net = mdr_col_use }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_water_frame = mdr_col_titan_water }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_titan_water_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_titan_water_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_water_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_food_frame = mdr_col_titan_food }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_titan_food_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_titan_food_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_food_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_energy_frame = mdr_col_titan_energy }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_titan_energy_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_titan_energy_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_energy_frame = 1 }
	set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_oxygen_frame = mdr_col_titan_oxygen }
	divide_variable = { mdr_col_titan_oxygen_frame = 2 }
	round_variable = mdr_col_titan_oxygen_frame
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_oxygen_frame = 1 }
}

# Each settler uses supplies; modules make them, and the route brings 6 of each a week.
mdr_col_titan_weekly = {
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = mdr_col_titan_pop }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_use = 0.05 }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_titan_water = mdr_col_use }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_titan_food = mdr_col_use }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_titan_energy = mdr_col_use }
	subtract_from_variable = { mdr_col_titan_oxygen = mdr_col_use }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = mdr_col_titan_greenhouse }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = 0.9 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_food = mdr_col_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = mdr_col_titan_mine }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = 0.8 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_water = mdr_col_made }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_oxygen = mdr_col_made }
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = mdr_col_titan_reactor }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_made = 1.1 }

		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_energy = 6 }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_oxygen = 6 }
	}

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_titan_water > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_water = 100 } }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_titan_oxygen > 100 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_oxygen = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { mdr_col_titan_water < 15 } check_variable = { mdr_col_titan_food < 15 } check_variable = { mdr_col_titan_energy < 15 } check_variable = { mdr_col_titan_oxygen < 15 } } }
		add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_morale = -3 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_titan_morale < 25 } check_variable = { mdr_col_titan_pop > 0 } } add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_pop = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { has_country_flag = mdr_col_titan_warned } } set_country_flag = mdr_col_titan_warned country_event = { id = mdr_space.4 } }
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = mdr_col_titan_warned
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_titan_morale < 100 } } add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_morale = 1 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_col_titan_morale < 0 } } set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_morale = 0 } }
	# Science of the colony.
	set_temp_variable = { mdr_col_science = mdr_col_titan_pop }
	multiply_temp_variable = { mdr_col_science = 0.09 }
	add_to_variable = { mdr_space_science = mdr_col_science }
	mdr_col_titan_frames = yes
}

mdr_col_titan_send = {
	add_to_variable = { mdr_col_titan_pop = 4 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = mdr_col_titan_pop compare = greater_than value = mdr_col_titan_cap } } set_variable = { mdr_col_titan_pop = mdr_col_titan_cap } }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -3.1 }
